legendary.atomicdawn.bloodied.desc: More damage the lower your health
legendary.atomicdawn.furious.desc: +5% damage per consecutive hit on the same target
legendary.atomicdawn.instigating.desc: Double damage against targets at full health
legendary.atomicdawn.explosive.desc: Hits explode for 20% extra area damage
legendary.atomicdawn.lightweight.desc: Faster draw and steadier on the move
legendary.atomicdawn.adrenal.desc: +5% damage per kill in a streak, up to +30%. Streaks end 10 seconds after your last kill.
legendary.atomicdawn.aristocrats.desc: Up to +50% damage the more currency you carry (full bonus at 128).
legendary.atomicdawn.berserkers.desc: Up to +95% damage the lower your armor.
legendary.atomicdawn.ferals.desc: Up to +50% damage the more feral you are as a Ghoul.
legendary.atomicdawn.gourmands.desc: Up to +30% damage the more fed and watered you are. Ghouls use their Glow instead.
legendary.atomicdawn.juggernauts.desc: Up to +25% damage the higher your health.
legendary.atomicdawn.junkies.desc: +10% damage per harmful status effect on you, up to +50%.
legendary.atomicdawn.lucid.desc: Up to +30% damage the more lucid you are as a Ghoul.
legendary.atomicdawn.medics.desc: Hitting an ally heals them for half the damage instead of hurting them.
legendary.atomicdawn.mutants.desc: +10% damage per mutation you have, up to +30%.
legendary.atomicdawn.nocturnal.desc: Up to +50% damage at night, peaking at midnight.
legendary.atomicdawn.snipers.desc: +50% damage against targets 24 or more blocks away.
legendary.atomicdawn.stalkers.desc: +50% damage on sneak attacks against targets that aren't fighting you.
legendary.atomicdawn.suppressors.desc: Hits weaken the target, reducing its damage for 5 seconds.
legendary.atomicdawn.two_shot.desc: Fires an extra projectile that deals 25% bonus damage.
legendary.atomicdawn.vampires.desc: Hits restore 2% of your max health.
legendary.atomicdawn.bashers.desc: +50% bash damage when hitting with the weapon itself.
legendary.atomicdawn.heavy_hitters.desc: +40% damage on fully charged power attacks.
legendary.atomicdawn.last_shot.desc: 50% chance for the last round in the magazine to deal double damage.
legendary.atomicdawn.pick_pocketers.desc: 25% chance for kills to earn you currency.
legendary.atomicdawn.poisoners.desc: Hits poison the target and deal 30% extra poison damage.
legendary.atomicdawn.pyro_technicians.de: Hits set the target on fire and deal 30% extra fire damage.
legendary.atomicdawn.riposting.desc: While guarding (sneaking), reflect 50% of melee damage back at the attacker.
legendary.atomicdawn.barbarian.desc: +1 Strength per kill in a streak while held, up to +3.
legendary.atomicdawn.blocker.desc: Take 40% less melee damage while guarding (sneaking).
legendary.atomicdawn.ghosts.desc: 10% chance on hit to turn invisible for 3 seconds.
legendary.atomicdawn.glowing.desc: Kills give Ghouls 15 Glow; for humans they release a radiation burst on nearby enemies.
legendary.atomicdawn.lucky.desc: V.A.T.S. hits fill the critical meter 50% faster.

special.atomicdawn.endurance.desc: Physical toughness. Increases maximum health and powers Endurance cards.
special.atomicdawn.charisma.desc: Presence and leadership. Provides capacity for team-oriented cards.
special.atomicdawn.intelligence.desc: Know-how. Reduces weapon condition loss and powers Intelligence cards.
special.atomicdawn.agility.desc: Speed and reflexes. Increases maximum Action Points and powers Agility cards.
special.atomicdawn.luck.desc: Fortune favours you. Speeds up the critical meter and powers Luck cards.

perk.atomicdawn.inspirational.desc: Allied players nearby earn more XP.

perk.atomicdawn.efficient_targeting.desc: V.A.T.S. attacks cost fewer Action Points.

bestiary.atomicdawn.zombie: A shambling corpse that never got the memo. Slow, relentless, and drawn to the living in packs.
bestiary.atomicdawn.zombie_villager: A former settler, now one of the hungry dead. Rumour says a weakness potion and a golden apple can bring them back.
bestiary.atomicdawn.husk: Desert-dried zombie that shrugs off the sun. Its touch leaves you starving.
bestiary.atomicdawn.drowned: Waterlogged dead lurking in rivers and flooded ruins. Some carry tridents.
bestiary.atomicdawn.skeleton: Bone-dry archer that keeps its distance. Close the gap or find cover.
bestiary.atomicdawn.stray: A frost-bitten skeleton whose arrows slow their target.
bestiary.atomicdawn.bogged: A mossy swamp skeleton loosing poisoned arrows from the murk.
bestiary.atomicdawn.wither_skeleton: Towering Nether sentry. Its blade withers flesh; its skull is a prized trophy.
bestiary.atomicdawn.creeper: A silent, hissing walking bomb. Keep moving, keep your distance, never let it close in.
bestiary.atomicdawn.spider: Wall-climbing hunter. Peaceful in daylight, aggressive at night.
bestiary.atomicdawn.cave_spider: Small, fast and venomous. Spawns from cobwebbed spawners in old mineshafts.
bestiary.atomicdawn.enderman: Tall, teleporting stranger. Don't meet its eyes and stay near water.
bestiary.atomicdawn.endermite: Tiny pest that sometimes follows a thrown ender pearl. Endermen hate it.
bestiary.atomicdawn.silverfish: Hides inside stone blocks and swarms when disturbed.
bestiary.atomicdawn.witch: Potion-slinging hermit that heals itself mid-fight. Rush it down before it drinks.
bestiary.atomicdawn.slime: Bouncing gel that splits when struck. Found in swamps and deep slime chunks.
bestiary.atomicdawn.magma_cube: A molten slime of the Nether. Splits like its cousin and burns to the touch.
bestiary.atomicdawn.blaze: Fire elemental guarding Nether fortresses. Volleys fireballs from the air.
bestiary.atomicdawn.ghast: Weeping giant of the Nether skies. Return its fireballs to sender.
bestiary.atomicdawn.phantom: Insomnia made flesh. Sleep regularly and it will never find you.
bestiary.atomicdawn.guardian: Spiked one-eyed sentinel of ocean monuments. Its laser charges before firing.
bestiary.atomicdawn.elder_guardian: Ancient warden of the monument. Curses intruders with crushing fatigue.
bestiary.atomicdawn.shulker: Shelled turret of the End cities. Its bullets send targets floating.
bestiary.atomicdawn.vex: Summoned spirit that phases through walls. Kill the evoker and they fade.
bestiary.atomicdawn.vindicator: Axe-swinging raider. Hits hard and fast; a shield buys time.
bestiary.atomicdawn.evoker: Illager spellcaster. Summons fangs and vexes; carries a Totem of Undying.
bestiary.atomicdawn.pillager: Crossbow raider. Patrols the wasteland and leads raids on settlements.
bestiary.atomicdawn.ravager: Armoured beast of the raids. Shatters crops and shields alike.
bestiary.atomicdawn.piglin_brute: Elite bastion guard. Unlike other piglins, gold won't calm it.
bestiary.atomicdawn.hoglin: Hulking Nether boar. Fears warped fungus and nether portals.
bestiary.atomicdawn.zoglin: A hoglin twisted by the Overworld. Attacks anything that moves.
bestiary.atomicdawn.warden: Blind horror of the deep dark. Hunts by sound. Don't fight it; leave.
bestiary.atomicdawn.breeze: Wind spirit of the trial chambers. Deflects arrows and leaps unpredictably.
bestiary.atomicdawn.creaking: Woodland stalker that freezes when watched. Destroy its heart to end it.
bestiary.atomicdawn.ender_dragon: The final guardian of the End. Destroy its healing crystals first.
bestiary.atomicdawn.wither: A three-headed engine of destruction. Summon it only far from home.
holotape.atomicdawn.test.desc: A scratched holotape with a hand-written label: "TESTING... 1, 2, 3."
holotape.atomicdawn.test.author: Unknown Vault Dweller
holotape.atomicdawn.echoes_of_the_past.d: A battered holotape left at an abandoned campsite. The label reads: "If anyone finds this — keep going."
holotape.atomicdawn.last_shift.desc: A coal-dusted holotape wedged under a collapsed beam. Scratched into the casing: "T. HARLAN — 2ND SHIFT."
holotape.atomicdawn.last_shift.author: Tamara Harlan, Miner
holotape.atomicdawn.the_waters_fine.desc: A maintenance log tape from the pump station control desk. A sticky note reads: "Readings nominal. Do NOT escalate."
holotape.atomicdawn.stormwatch_final_rep: A research holotape stamped with the station's weather service seal. The label just says "FINAL."
holotape.atomicdawn.checkpoint_charlie.d: A military-issue holotape left in the checkpoint's duty locker. Stencilled: "CHECKPOINT C — SITREP."
holotape.atomicdawn.gone_fishing.desc: A waterlogged holotape tucked in a tackle box. Someone has written "Back by supper" on the label.
holotape.atomicdawn.gone_fishing.author: Earlene Thompson, Fisherman
holotape.atomicdawn.rangers_warning.desc: A worn holotape pinned beside the cabin's trail map. The label reads: "LISTEN BEFORE YOU HEAD UP."
holotape.atomicdawn.everything_must_go.d: A holotape left behind the store counter, next to a hand-painted "CLOSING SALE" sign.
holotape.atomicdawn.the_last_broadcast.d: A radio station promo holotape, still in its sleeve. Someone kept it with their travelling things.
holotape.atomicdawn.little_things.desc: A carefully kept holotape wrapped in cloth. The label is decorated with a child's drawing of a sun.
holotape.atomicdawn.little_things.author: Sarah Mitchell, Survivor
holotape.atomicdawn.property_of_the_comp: A corporate holotape with an embossed logo. The label warns: "CONFIDENTIAL — MANAGEMENT ONLY."
quest.atomicdawn.welcome_to_appalachia.d: The Vault doors are open. Get your bearings with the Pip-Boy, gather the basics, and deal with the dead that roam nearby.
quest.atomicdawn.lost_signal.desc: A survivor left a holotape behind. Play it on your Pip-Boy and hear what they had to say.
quest.atomicdawn.wasteland_survival.desc: Gather supplies, brave the irradiated wastes, and learn how the dead behave.
quest.atomicdawn.bug_hunt.desc: The spiders around here are getting bold. Thin their numbers.
quest.atomicdawn.a_new_beginning.desc: The Vault doors are open. Get moving, level up, and gather what you can from the world outside.
quest.atomicdawn.scrap_for_survival.desc: You can't fight the wasteland with your fists. Gather the metal and powder you need to build proper workbenches.
quest.atomicdawn.a_place_to_call_home.de: A safe camp is the difference between life and death. Claim a spot with your C.A.M.P. and start building.
quest.atomicdawn.an_unhealthy_glow.desc: The wasteland is saturated with radiation. Walk into it, feel it on the Geiger counter, then learn how to purge it.
quest.atomicdawn.armed_and_dangerous.des: Put those workbenches to use. Build a gun, make ammunition for it, and see how quickly it wears out.
quest.atomicdawn.echoes_of_the_past.desc: Somebody recorded a warning before the bombs fell. Listen to it, then go find one of the ruins they mention.
quest.atomicdawn.the_world_beyond.desc: There's more to Appalachia than the land around your camp. Push further and see what the wasteland has become.
quest.atomicdawn.rebuilding_tomorrow.des: Every gun you tear apart teaches you something. Scrap weapons, learn their mods, and fit your own.
quest.atomicdawn.tools_of_the_trade.desc: Guns wear down and survivors need an edge. Keep your weapon in working order and put your perk cards to use.

quest.atomicdawn.the_last_miner.desc: The ash-choked mines of this region once powered a civilization. See what's left.
quest.atomicdawn.contaminated_waters.des: The toxic valley's water supply is poisoned. Survive long enough to understand why.
quest.atomicdawn.field_research.desc: Someone was conducting research in the irradiated mire. Find what they left behind.
quest.atomicdawn.military_remnants.desc: Pre-war military presence still haunts the crimson bog. Clear them out.
quest.atomicdawn.roadside_assistance.des: The old highway through Burning Springs is a graveyard of vehicles and lost supplies.
quest.atomicdawn.the_watcher.desc: Something is using the old lookout towers in the Savage Divide. Find out what.
quest.atomicdawn.storm_warning.desc: The monitoring stations in Skyline Valley were still transmitting when the bombs fell. What are they broadcasting now?

power_armor_mod.atomicdawn.headlamp_stan: A basic headlamp. Use the Pip-Boy light key to switch it on (light level 12).

power_armor_mod.atomicdawn.headlamp_purp: A headlamp behind a purple lens (light level 13).

power_armor_mod.atomicdawn.rad_scrubbers: +25% radiation resistance and removes 1 rad per second.
power_armor_mod.atomicdawn.jet_pack.desc: Hold jump in the air to fly upward. Drains the fusion core quickly.
power_armor_mod.atomicdawn.optimized_bra: Melee and unarmed V.A.T.S. attacks cost 25% less AP. Only the main-hand arm counts.
power_armor_mod.atomicdawn.tesla_bracers: Unarmed attacks deal 3 extra energy damage. Only the main-hand arm counts.
power_armor_mod.atomicdawn.hydraulic_bra: +40% unarmed damage. Only the main-hand arm counts.
power_armor_mod.atomicdawn.rusty_knuckle: Unarmed attacks make targets bleed for 4 seconds. Only the main-hand arm counts.
power_armor_mod.atomicdawn.calibrated_sh: Softer heavy landings (a pair removes the landing stagger) and +15% jump height per leg.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.adrenal: Kills grant Speed for 4 seconds per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.aristoc: Up to 4% less damage per piece, reaching full strength at experience level 30.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.assassi: 8% less damage from players per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.auto_st: Below 25% health, heal 10% per piece. 60 second cooldown.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.bolster: Up to 6% less damage per piece the lower your health.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.chamele: The suit turns invisible after standing still for 2 seconds.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.cloakin: Being hit makes the suit invisible for 1 second per piece. 20 second cooldown.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.extermi: 15% less damage from arthropods per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.ghoul_s: 15% less damage from undead per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.hunters: 15% less damage from animals per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.lucid.d: Immune to Nausea, Darkness and Blindness.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.mutant_: 15% less damage from illagers per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.mutants: 5% less damage per piece while above a quarter of your max rads.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.nocturn: 5% less damage per piece at night.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.overeat: 5% less damage per piece while well fed.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.regener: Out of combat, regain 0.25 health per second per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.trouble: 15% less damage from golems and other constructs per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.vanguar: Up to 5% less damage per piece the higher your health.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.zealots: 15% less damage from fiery Nether creatures per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.element: 6% less energy and magic damage per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.pain_ki: Immune to Slowness and Mining Fatigue.
V.A.T.S. attacks cost 3% less AP per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.arms_ke: Weapons lose condition 5% slower per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.burning: Melee attackers are set on fire for 1 second per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.cavalie: 3% less damage per piece while moving.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.dissipa: Lose 1 rad per piece whenever you're hit.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.durabil: Armor pieces lose condition 10% slower per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.electri: Melee attackers take 0.5 energy damage per piece.

power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.healthy: +1 maximum health (half a heart) per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.pack_ra: Pulls dropped items to you from 1 block per piece.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.sentine: 3% less damage per piece while standing still.
power_armor_legendary.atomicdawn.toxic.d: Melee attackers are poisoned for 0.5 seconds per piece.

mutation.atomicdawn.adrenal_reaction.des: + up to 50% damage as your health drops / -2 max hearts
mutation.atomicdawn.bird_bones.desc: +4 Agility, lighter and falls take half damage / -4 Strength
mutation.atomicdawn.carnivore.desc: Meat counts double / plant food gives nothing
mutation.atomicdawn.chameleon.desc: Invisible after standing still for 2 s without armor
mutation.atomicdawn.electrically_charged: Melee attackers may get shocked / the shock stings you too
mutation.atomicdawn.empath.desc: Party members near you take 25% less damage / you take 33% more
mutation.atomicdawn.grounded.desc: 40% less energy damage taken / your energy weapons deal 50% less
mutation.atomicdawn.healing_factor.desc: Regenerate health quickly / beneficial effects last 55% shorter
mutation.atomicdawn.herbivore.desc: Plant food counts double / meat gives nothing
mutation.atomicdawn.herd_mentality.desc: +2 to all S.P.E.C.I.A.L. in a party / -2 when alone
mutation.atomicdawn.twisted_muscles.desc: +25% melee damage / guns are less accurate
mutation.atomicdawn.unstable_isotope.des: Melee attackers may set off a radiation blast
item.atomicdawn.nuka_cola.desc: Restores a little health and AP, but irradiates you
item.atomicdawn.nuka_cola_cranberry.desc: Restores a little health and grants bonus XP for a while
item.atomicdawn.nuka_cherry.desc: Restores a lot of health and a little AP, but irradiates you
item.atomicdawn.nuka_cola_dark.desc: Briefly raises Strength and Endurance but lowers Perception
item.atomicdawn.nuka_cola_orange.desc: Restores a little health and AP, but irradiates you
item.atomicdawn.nuka_cola_quantum.desc: Restores a huge amount of health and AP, but heavily irradiates you
item.atomicdawn.nuka_cola_twist.desc: Boosts a random S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stat for a while
item.atomicdawn.nuka_cola_wild.desc: Restores a little health and AP, but irradiates you
